text:
maya: Heads up — seeing 30–40ms tail latency spikes from eu-west rack-17 starting ~08:12 UTC. GPU job retries + some kernel OOMs. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/eu-west/rack-17
monitoring-bot: ALERT: ToR port tor2-eth3 flapping (crc_errors=420, rx_drop=98) in last 10m — severity: warning
sam: Ran ethtool on rack-17-node-04, lots of RX CRC. suspect copper cable degradation between tor2 and agg-switch-a. snippet:
```
# ethtool -S eth3 | egrep "crc|rx_drop"
rx_crc_errors: 412
rx_missed_errors: 5
```
jia: Are dedicated pools impacted? We have heavy traffic on dedicated-eu2-512 for a rollout — customers seeing ~2x token runtimes. Might need to isolate hosts before it ripples to other tenants.
leo: Proposed action: soft-quarantine rack-17 hosts (no new allocations), start draining slice-backed GPUs, route new dedicated allocations away from eu-west until we validate. Quick cost note: that'll reduce available dedicated capacity ~8% (temporary). @maya can you open an isolation/carveout ticket?
maya: Created INC-4421 and kicked off drains on 6 GPUs. Started migration for 3 critical slices. Notifying network to RMA cable. drain command used:
```
redwoodctl node drain rack-17-node-04 --gpus 2 --grace 600
```
monitoring-bot: MIGRATION: rack-17-node-04 drain progress 2/6 GPUs drained
sam: Short-term routing tweak: prefer-dedicated=eu1 if eu-west pool health <92%, fall back to quantized-model variants for non-critical workloads. Also suggest bumping prefill threshold for warm pool to reduce egress microbursts.
jia: +1. Also request packet-capture on tor2-eth3 for next 30m to confirm microburst vs sustained CRC. If cable ETA >4h, propose temporary fractional carveout for high-SLA tenants (route to eu1/eu2).
maya: Network ETA for replacement: ~3.5h. Continuing drains & migration, will update INC-4421 with progress and cost estimate for temporary carveout. Will post a follow-up when drains finish or if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
